test_observer: test the TestObserver class to watch two built-in bots via an observer in StarCraft II
create_game_setup: create a game setup with two computer players and an observer using RequestCreateGame
join_game_observer: join a game as an observer with InterfaceOptions to receive cheap observations
step_game_loop: step the game loop with controller.step(16) and observe game state changes
check_game_outcome: check game outcome by observing player_result after game completion
